aurelm_airplay_probe.title: AirPlay Test
aurelm_airplay_probe.description: AirPlay receiver for the head unit: the iPhone's screen mirroring on the centre screen while parked, with its sound on the car's speakers. Also the network test. Needs the AirPlay test service.
aurelm_airplay_probe.author: custom

aurelm_emby.title: Emby
aurelm_emby.description: The head unit as a cast target for the Emby phone app: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then choose "BMW iDrive" in Emby's cast menu. Step 1: the connection and the commands; playback comes next. Needs the Emby cast service.
aurelm_emby.author: custom
